== Rules of selecting maps (BO5): ==
* Each map can only be played once per match
* We randomly choose who rejects/chooses first by entering the command: /cmd rnd player1 player2
* Player1 tosses 1 map
* Player2 tosses 1 map
* Player1 chooses a map
* Player2 chooses a map
* When player1 wins 2-0, player2 chooses the 3rd map and player1 chooses the 4th map
* When the score is 1-1, the 3rd map is chosen by player1 and the 4th map is chosen by player2
* When the score is 2-2, the players play the so-called "decider" on a map that has not been previously selected or rejected
== Points ==
* Playing the match +1 point
* Winning the match +3 points
* WO winning the match +4 points (3-0 in maps, 90-0 in frags)
* Losing the match by WO +0 points (0-3 in maps, 0-90 in frags)
* (example: score 3-2, points 4-1; score 3-1, points 4-1; score 3-0, points 4-1)

After the end of the group phase, there will be a PLAYOFF phase.

== Playoffs (BO5/BO7) ==
The best 4 players from the regular phase from each division will advance to the PLAYOFF phase.
* Semifinal1: Player1 vs Player4 (BO5)
* Semifinal2: Player2 vs Player3 (BO5)
* Final: Winner Semifinal1 vs Winner Semifinal2 (BO7)
* 3rd place game: Loser Semifinal1 vs Loser Semifinal2 (BO7)
''(However, in the semi-final, player1 and player2 have a handicap in the form of one plus map, i.e. the matches start with a score of 1-0.)''

The last player in division 1 plays a game to stay in the division against the winner of PLAYOFF divisions 2 (BO5).
''(i.e. last player of the regular phase div1 vs winner of the playoffs div2)''

Selecting maps according to the rules described above (BO5).

The FINAL matches will be played in the BO7 system (final and 3rd place games).
Selecting maps (BO7):
* Each map can only be played once per match
* We draw who chooses first by entering the command: /cmd rnd player1 player2
* Player1 chooses a map
* Player2 chooses a map etc.
* If one of the players is ahead by at least 2 maps, for example player1, the next map is chosen by player2 and then player1.
* When the score is 3-3, the players play the so-called "decider" on a map that has not been previously selected.

== Arranging matches ==
Please schedule matches with your opponents on the #schedules channel so that the league admins can see your commitment (this will be important when handing out WO).
== Timetable ==
Rigidly established, 1 week to play a match with the possibility of extending it by 1 week.
After exceeding these deadlines, walkovers will be given. It is possible to play your matches in advance if your opponent agrees.
== Walkovers ==
* If the player is unable to play the match on the scheduled date, he or she loses due to WO. If two players are unable to play their match on the scheduled date, both players lose due to WO. 
* It is possible to play a match in which a WO was awarded only if the player who won the match by WO agrees to it. 
* Matches in which a WO is awarded to the detriment of both players do not fall under this exception.
== Additional rules ==
* inability to add players during the league
* we apply the principle of fair play, no betting, we play using commonly accepted rulesets (smackdown, qcon) and clients (nQuake, ezQuake).
* if players are caught not applying the fair play rules, they will be subject to consequences, after considering each case individually.
== Pings ==
Try to play so that the pings are equal or close. It's a Polish league, so playing on Polish servers is recommended. The exception is Goorol, who agreed to play from US. In matches against Goorol the mininum difference in ping is 50ms.
== Match reporting ==
After completing the match, the winner posts screenshots with the result from each map played on the #results channel at discord.
